newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 96/97 PC shipments 7.19 mln units, up 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan 96/97 PC shipments 7.19 mln units, up 26 pct.

text.p: Japan domestic personal computer shipments totalled 7.19 million units in the year to the end of March 1997, up 26 percent from the previous business year, a trade association announced on Wednesday.

The Japan Electronic Industry Development Association, which groups 21 PC makers in Japan, said the figure fell short of its target of 7.5 million units. It said this was a reaction to high growth of 70 percent in the previous year.

It said it expects Japan's domestic PC shipments to grow 22 percent to 8.8 million units in the year from April 1, reflecting continuing strong investment in the information business by corporations and individual users.
The value of shipments is expected to rise 17 percent to 2.1 trillion yen in the 1997/98 business year, up 26 percent from an estimated 1.75 trillion yen in the 1996/97 year.
